subject.title: fix: delegated subagents honor per-call timeouts

question: Should `sessions_spawn` expose a supported per-call `timeoutSeconds` override, and if so should the structured parameter be the only authoritative timeout contract?
rationale: Current documentation says the public tool does not accept a per-call override, while the PR adds that API and additionally derives policy from unstructured task text; choosing the permanent public contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve structured override only
options.body: Keep the new `timeoutSeconds` parameter and its native/ACP forwarding, but remove all `HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` parsing and mismatch enforcement.

options.title: Retain configured-default-only behavior
options.body: Reject the new public parameter and address long-run needs through the existing configured subagent timeout until a broader delegation-budget design is approved.

options.title: Design a formal handoff contract
options.body: Pause this PR and define a typed, versioned delegation metadata contract before enforcing handoff budgets beyond the structured tool input.

recommendation.title: Approve structured override only
recommendation.body: Keep the new `timeoutSeconds` parameter and its native/ACP forwarding, but remove all `HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` parsing and mismatch enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the incident context and proposed contract, although a current-main owner should be added once feature-history routing is available.
